title: Chapter 121 Fake Products Are The Most Hated
content:
Chapter 121 Fake Products Are The Most Hated

In the heart of God Ryan, as long as he still maintains his status as a god, then he can accept the belief and admiration of countless believers, and continue to maintain this position full of countless glory and power.

And if he loses his current identity, he will fall to the altar, lose his strength, and lose all his current glory and status.

Even my current life may not be in my control, so how can this make a person enjoy the taste of being superior, who is used to the gods of glory and wealth, and can accept it!

Therefore, at this time, in the heart of Ryan God, he has already made up his mind, if the mysterious strong man on the opposite side refuses to accept the conditions he just offered.

Then it will offer a condition that will make it even harder for countless strong men to refuse.

That is, he will give up his current independent status, hand over part of his authority, and seek refuge with the strong man on the opposite side, becoming a subordinate god under him, and becoming his subordinate from now on, relying on others.

You know, even on this continent, there are countless gods all over the sky, adding up to hundreds of him.

However, there are very few of them who are willing to be subordinates to others, to become a subordinate god whose freedom is restricted, and whose status is restricted by other gods.

Even if ordinary gods are forced into desperation by others, they may step into the ruins at any time and be completely annihilated. That is to ensure their own glory and dignity as a god. They would rather die than give up everything and become others. One from God!

You must know that becoming a subordinate god of other gods, although there is a gap in freedom and status, generally speaking, there are not too many restrictions.

It's just that they need to obey the orders of their main god at certain times to complete some tasks and things. In addition, in the face of the attacks of other gods, they must be consistent with their main gods, and there are no major requirements for others.

However, for the sake of their own dignity, many gods would rather die than reject such a modest request, just to ensure their own independence and the greatest glory of being a god.

Therefore, countless powerful gods on the continent are proud and honored to have a god as their subordinate god.

And use this as capital, with other gods of the same level, as boasting capital and talk.

Now Ryan is willing to make this kind of decision, and he has made great sincerity and determination. He will not hesitate to give up all his face and dignity, but also to ensure his own survival.

Anyway, even if I bow my knees at that time, it will only be to such a mysterious strong man in front of me, who is of the same level, and he should not humiliate himself too much!

As for the rest of the time, he was still the god Ryan who was aloof and revered by countless mortals and ants. Standing at the top of countless people, sitting on countless life spans overlooking the vicissitudes of the world.

Compared with this kind of treatment and income, the little bit of dignity I paid was nothing, at most, I was humiliated by the white-robed man. Not even one nap is enough.

However, hearing God Rui En's begging for mercy, the white-robed man was not only not happy, but even more angry, and his attacks became more and more fierce!

Thinking that the person in front of him has reached the realm easily, and he has to go through untold hardships, all kinds of sharpening, and countless calamities before he can cultivate.

I wanted to cultivate to the realm of an immortal, how many enemies I killed, how many opponents I suppressed, and the price of radiation along the way, my whole hands were full of dripping blood red.

And this person in front of him, as a person in the same realm as himself, is so shameless, and his identity as a strong person makes the white-robed man who is originally unbalanced feel even more insulted.

Anyway, I can't live for a long time, so I would rather do my best to kill this scum, lest he lose face as a strong man like us.

Thinking of this, the jade plate suddenly burst into colorful light, and countless colorful horses swept out, dancing in the air. Then practice towards the law of nobility, and just like that, the remaining people in the sky who have realized the law of nobility are wrapped up by the whole colored horse training.

The whole horse is wrapped in countless people, bulging, people who have realized the laws of nobility, pushing around inside, as if they are about to burst out at any time.

But I saw the man in white robe pinch the magic formula in his hand, the whole horse tightened violently, and then turned around.

It was like drying a wet quilt, tightening it from both sides, and those noble laws disappeared like water.

It's just that it didn't flow down, but was directly absorbed by Pi Lian in large quantities, making Pi Lian even more powerful, and continued to digest and devour the remaining laws.

Seeing that his own laws are really going to disappear quickly, he is really going to lose his identity as a god. God Ryan couldn't care less about the god's reserve, and stated his conditions quickly and repeatedly.

It's just that just halfway through my words, I was directly interrupted by the next action of the white-robed man, and the colorful horses burst into light.

In an instant, all the laws of nobility in it were crushed and devoured, leaving nothing left.

And God Ryan's face also changed, his whole face turned pale, and the golden light all over his body slowly dissipated and faded, gradually revealing his original human appearance.

With a crackling sound, cracks appeared one after another on the real body of Ryan God, and then expanded rapidly, covering the whole body. The whole body was like porcelain that was about to crack, as if it would shatter at the touch of a touch.

"You and I……"

God Ryan was still muttering, as if he was saying something, but he couldn't believe it.

He never imagined that the white-robed man in front of him, who had no grievances or enmities with him, would be so ruthless and kill him.

Regardless of the gods and spirits, they agreed with each other that they would not really fight to the death.

All believers on both sides are engaged in a war between mortals, and the oath to determine the division of their respective interests is based on their victory or defeat.

Let his original wishful thinking be completely overthrown, and his own carelessness and assumptions are completely thrown away, and his glorious life has ended his glorious and magnificent life as a god!

With a gust of wind blowing, the divine body that was originally majestic and full of holiness in mid-air was completely shattered, and turned into a gust of breeze and blown away, everything seemed to have never appeared before.

Seeing that the enemy in front of him was dead, the man in white robe looked around. After confirming that there were no other strong men peeping around, he lowered his head and nodded to the mortal emperor who had resurrected himself and summoned him below.

He said to Zhong Yu through sound transmission that he had already dealt with this enemy, and had checked all around, and there was no danger, so the agreement between himself and him had been completed, and the time now belonged to him.

He is going to take a good look at this strange world, and appreciate another life that belongs to him, even if it will disappear in an hour or two!
